stem: Which statement about the members of the Commission on Human Rights is correct under Article XIII, Section 17 of the 1987 Constitution?
choices: All must be natural-born citizens, and all must be members of the Bar.
All must be natural-born citizens, and a majority must be members of the Bar.
They may be naturalized citizens, as long as all of them are members of the Bar.
Only the Chairman must be a natural-born citizen and a member of the Bar.
answer: All must be natural-born citizens, and a majority must be members of the Bar.
hints: Section 17 sets two conditions for the members: one about citizenship and one about being a lawyer. A correct choice must get both right.
Recall the citizenship rule first. Does it cover all the members or only the Chairman? Does it say natural-born, or any citizen?
Then recall the lawyer rule. Does it say all the members, or "a majority"? Keep only the choice that matches both rules.

solution.methodName: Recall the exact words of the provision

steps.action: Find the provision: Article XIII, Section 17 of the 1987 Constitution.
Read it: the CHR has "a Chairman and four Members who must be natural-born citizens of the Philippines and a majority of whom shall be members of the Bar."
Citizenship: all five must be natural-born citizens.
steps.why: The words "who must be natural-born citizens" describe the Chairman and all four Members. Naturalized citizens do not qualify.

steps.action: Lawyers: only "a majority" must be members of the Bar.
steps.why: A member of the Bar is a lawyer. A majority means more than half, so at least 3 of the 5, not all of them.

steps.action: The answer is: all must be natural-born citizens, and a majority must be members of the Bar.

trapNotes.All must be natural-born citizens, and a: The citizenship part is right, but Section 17 says only "a majority" must be members of the Bar, not all.
trapNotes.They may be naturalized citizens, as lon: Section 17 says the members "must be natural-born citizens". Being a lawyer does not make up for that.
trapNotes.Only the Chairman must be a natural-born: The natural-born rule covers the Chairman and all four Members, not only the Chairman.
